data: stxt like field_int-stxt,
      stxt_leng type i.

* Bei Schablonen prüfen, ob TEXT mit gültigem Zeichen beginnt
  if dyn_field_attr-type = rpyty_dynp_ftype-template
  or dyn_field_attr-type = rpyty_dynp_ftype-push_template
  or dyn_field_attr-type = rpyty_dynp_ftype-frame_template.
    if dyn_field_attr-text ne space.
      shift dyn_field_attr-text left deleting leading ' '.
      if dyn_field_attr-text(1) cn '_?'.
        message e113 with 'FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS'
                           dyn_field_attr-name
                          'TEXT'
                           dyn_field_attr-text
                     raising illegal_field_value.
      endif.
    endif.
  endif.

* mögliche Angaben zu Ikonen verarbeiten

  icon_id = ' '.
  icon_quick = ' '.

    if dyn_field_attr-type = rpyty_dynp_ftype-infobutton. "feste
      dyn_field_attr-icon_name = 'ICON_DIALGHELP'.        "Ikone
      icon_leng = 2.
      icon_id = '@OH@'.  "#EC NOTEXT
    endif.                                                "erzwingen
*   mögliche Ikonenangaben zu Textfeldern:
*   falls ein Ikonenname angegeben ist, Ikoneninformationen beschaffen
    if not ( dyn_field_attr-icon_name is initial )
    and  dyn_field_attr-type <> rpyty_dynp_ftype-infobutton.

      if dyn_field_attr-type = rpyty_dynp_ftype-push.
        perform is_icon(saplseus) using dyn_field_attr-icon_name
                                        'P'
                               changing icon_leng
                                        icon_id
                                        icon_quick.
        if icon_leng = 0.
          message e113 with 'FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS'

                             dyn_field_attr-icon_name
